patterns.name: Not X, but Y contrast
patterns.pattern: \b(?:not|isn['?]t|aren['?]t|wasn['?]t|weren['?]t)\s+(?:just|only|merely|simply)?\s*[^.?!\n]{1,80}\b(?:but|rather|instead)\b[^.?!\n]{0,120}
patterns.hint: State the point directly instead of building it through a contrast.

patterns.name: Staged run-up
patterns.pattern: let's dive in|let's delve in|let's explore|let's break this down|here's what you need to know|without further ado|in today's fast-paced world|in today's digital age
patterns.hint: Skip the warm-up and start with the actual point.

patterns.name: One-line closer
patterns.pattern: (?m)^(?:That(?:'s| is) (?:the real|a game|what really) (?:win|difference|matters)\.|The bottom line is[^.\n]{0,80}\.|At the end of the day[^.\n]{0,80}\.)$
patterns.hint: If the line repeats what was already said, cut it.

patterns.name: Deep-sounding saying
patterns.pattern: the real question is|at its core|what really matters is|the heart of the matter|a testament to|a reminder that
patterns.hint: Replace the grand framing with a specific claim.

patterns.name: Forced triad
patterns.hint: Use three items only when the meaning truly needs three.

patterns.name: Overused AI word: delve
patterns.pattern: delve into|delves into|delving into|delve deeper
patterns.hint: Use a plain verb like explore, examine, or explain.

patterns.name: Overused AI word: landscape/realm/tapestry
patterns.pattern: landscape of|digital landscape|evolving landscape|realm of|tapestry of|rich tapestry
patterns.hint: Name the actual thing instead of using an abstract metaphor.

patterns.name: Overused AI word: pivotal/crucial
patterns.pattern: pivotal role|pivotal moment|crucial role|plays a crucial role|plays a vital role
patterns.hint: Say what happened or what the role actually was.

patterns.name: Inflated significance
patterns.pattern: marking a pivotal moment|underscores the importance|reflects broader trends|setting the stage for|an indelible mark|enduring legacy
patterns.hint: Keep the fact; drop the inflated significance.

patterns.name: Sales language
patterns.pattern: game-changer|cutting-edge|best-in-class|world-class|unlock the power|supercharge your|seamless experience|revolutionize the way
patterns.hint: Describe the concrete benefit instead of selling it.

patterns.name: Chatbot residue
patterns.pattern: great question|i hope this helps|let me know if you'd like|certainly!|of course!|as an ai language model|happy to help
patterns.hint: Remove conversational assistant leftovers.

patterns.name: Knowledge-limit disclaimer
patterns.pattern: as of my last update|as of my knowledge cutoff|i don't have access to real-time|based on available information
patterns.hint: State what is known, or say the source does not show it.

patterns.name: Filler transitions
patterns.pattern: furthermore|moreover|additionally|in conclusion|it is important to note|it is worth noting
patterns.hint: Use transitions only when they carry meaning.

patterns.name: Stacked hedges
patterns.pattern: \b(?:could potentially|might possibly|it is possible that|it could be argued that|may or may not)\b
patterns.hint: Keep a qualifier only when the meaning truly needs it.

patterns.name: Decorative emoji
patterns.hint: Remove decorative emoji from professional prose.

patterns.name: Decorative bold/label heading
patterns.hint: Use plain headings or prose; avoid bold-label formatting.

patterns.name: Vague authority
patterns.pattern: experts say|experts agree|studies show|research shows|many people believe|it is widely believed
patterns.hint: Name the source, or remove the unsupported authority claim.

patterns.name: Abstract noun phrase
patterns.pattern: \b(?:the importance of|the value of|the impact of|the power of|the beauty of)\s+[a-z][\w'-]*(?:\s+[a-z][\w'-]*){0,3}
patterns.hint: Show the importance through a concrete detail instead of naming it.

patterns.name: Colon label list
patterns.hint: If labels add no information, rewrite as plain prose.

patterns.name: Generic conclusion
patterns.pattern: in summary|to sum up|overall, it is clear that|all in all|in the grand scheme of things
patterns.hint: End on a concrete point instead of a generic summary.

banned_words: at the end of the day
